output.name: Hevalu
output.myth:
Kael the Netter cast for fallen stars every night and never once hauled one up. One night the net came back heavy and wet, and in it was a gull, the first he had ever caught. Her wing was in the mesh and she would not stop beating. Kael's hands shook. He thought of Hesk at the pole, who keeps count of everything taken, and he thought of the fallen star still falling somewhere past the Lamp Road. So he loosed the knot one thread at a time and let her go. Tavo took her up at once, laughing, and she went off over the Windward Reach with a square of net still tangled in her wing.

She is up there now. Hilun, the gull who carried messages up to Vel, hangs off her north-west, and Tavo was fond of that gull, which is a dangerous thing in a god. Lethún, the grey hen who hung behind crying when the sky drifted off, sits a little east of her, and the two of them call across the dark. Look for her when the wind is right. She goes back and forth between the lamps, and the knot-mark shows pale on her wing. Kael still casts. He comes home, empty-handed.
output.finding: Find Hilun, the Windward Gull, and go one hand-span south-east of it, where Hevalu flies with a pale knot-mark on her wing.
